dct_description_sm: This dataset contains a 4-category learning task with 3 separate conditions: virtual reality (VR), joystick manipulation (3D), and 2D with eye tracking (ET). 3 binary-valued stimuli were presented on faces of a cube. Of the 3 features, 2 were relevant to the cube's category, while 1 was not. The data from the ET condition were pulled from a previous study (the 100% feedback condition of McColeman, Ancell, & Blair, 2011. See README for full citation).
